verdict.rationale: Semgrep AppSec Platform has an API for listing deployments, findings, and projects, so issuing scoped credentials is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents API token creation, scopes, or least-privilege permissions for agents. Semgrep Secrets only detects leaked credentials in code, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
